subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR introduce `sessions.activity`, `session.activity`, and seven plugin activity hooks now, or should that contract stay behind the canonical session-activity design work?
rationale: The diff is not only a UI implementation; it creates public Gateway and plugin SDK contract surface while the broader session activity semantics remain unresolved in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127.

options.title: Rework Behind The Canonical Contract
options.body: Rebase the branch, keep only behavior that fits current task-ledger and chat scoping, and defer or reshape the new RPC/event/hooks until the canonical contract is accepted.

options.title: Accept The New Public Surface
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly approve the new RPC, websocket event, and hook names as the permanent compatibility contract after review.

options.title: Pause Or Close In Favor Of Current Main
options.body: If the merged Tasks page covers the near-term need, pause or close this branch and keep remaining activity semantics in the canonical issues.

recommendation.title: Rework Behind The Canonical Contract
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, keep only behavior that fits current task-ledger and chat scoping, and defer or reshape the new RPC/event/hooks until the canonical contract is accepted.
